requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Official City page returned and linked the current MV2 Geocortex viewer.
Current public Geocortex JavaScript configuration returned; no login, credential, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or private token was used.
Current public site map listing identified the GEParcels FeatureServer parcel layer and its ArcGIS service URL.
Layer schema, polygon geometry type, native FID/APN fields, source WKID 102100/3857, and GeoJSON support returned. Unsafe fields were not requested or retained.
Exact unchanged WUP point [33.9256769971331, -117.234944442388] returned features []; this exact-point miss is not evidence of citywide absence. Requested only FID/APN and geometry.

Bounded envelope query [-117.245,33.915,-117.225,33.935] returned parcel polygons with native FID/APN; response indicated exceededTransferLimit, so it is only a bounded sample and not a citywide inventory. Three full polygons are retained in the sample GeoJSON.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted to force a hit.
The retained polygons are a bounded anonymous service sample, not proof of full citywide coverage or completeness.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Native source field names and mapping are recorded here rather than in GeoJSON properties; each retained feature has only canonical APN identity.
Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The exact WUP point is not covered by a returned GEParcels polygon, or the point lies in a gap/edge condition; this was not generalized to the city.
The bounded query exceeded its transfer limit and does not establish parcel counts or complete coverage.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter/runtime qualification.
